name: statusline
description: Status band above the prompt: context bar, rate limits, git branch, lines changed, tokens and cost, like the claude-statusline script.

theme.title: Color theme
theme.description: catppuccin follows the Theme setting (Latte on a light theme, Mocha on a dark one); catppuccin-latte and catppuccin-mocha force one; default keeps the script's terminal colors

statusLine.title: Status line under the prompt
statusLine.description: Also pin a one-line summary under the prompt: desktop (while the desktop app is attached, which hides the band behind its next-step box), always, or off

col1Width.title: First column width
col1Width.description: Width of the first column, in cells

col2Width.title: Second column width
col2Width.description: Width of the second column, in cells

contextBarWidth.title: Context bar width
contextBarWidth.description: Width of the context-window bar, in cells

rateBarWidth.title: Rate-limit bar width
rateBarWidth.description: Width of each rate-limit bar, in cells
